Pipeline stage: Calibration

Source: R/pipeline-calibrate.R
calibrate.Rd

Fits a unidimensional IRT model to the responses in a pipeline and checks whether the items are fit to enter an item bank. The checks (thresholds from mv_rules()):

Usage

calibrate(p, model = "auto", dif = NULL, reference = NULL, ...)

Arguments

p

a pipeline with responses from add_responses().

model

the item type passed to mirt::mirt(), such as "Rasch", "2PL", "3PL", "graded" or "gpcm", or "auto" to let select_model() choose.

dif

logical; test for DIF. Defaults to TRUE when the pipeline has a grouping variable.

reference

the reference group for DIF. Defaults to the largest group.

...

further arguments passed to mirt::mirt().

Value

The pipeline with the fitted model (p$model), the DIF results (p$dif) and the calibration flags added.

Details

  • not_converged (block): The estimation did not converge.

  • model_fit (review): M2-based RMSEA above rmsea or CFI below cfi, which suggests more than one dimension or a poorly fitting model.

  • local_dependence (review): Pairs of items whose absolute Q3 residual correlation exceeds q3.

  • item_misfit (review): S-X2 item fit p-value below fit_alpha after fit_adjust adjustment.

  • parameter_range (review): Discrimination outside a_min to a_max, an absolute difficulty above b_max, or a guessing parameter above c_max.

  • dif_large (block) and dif_moderate (review): Differential item functioning between the groups given to add_responses(), classified with the ETS A/B/C rules. 0/1 items use the Mantel-Haenszel D-DIF statistic (category C: |D-DIF| at least dif_c and a significant Mantel-Haenszel test; B: At least dif_b and significant). Polytomous items use the standardized mean difference divided by the item's standard deviation with the Mantel test (dif_poly_c, dif_poly_b). Respondents are matched on their total score; with more than two groups each group is compared with the reference group.

  • low_reliability (review): Marginal reliability below reliability.

  • person_misfit (info): The share of respondents whose Zh (lz) person-fit statistic is below person_misfit; they are listed in p$persons.

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- add_responses(mv_pipeline(), certexam, items = 3:34, key = certexam_key,
                   group = "language")
p <- calibrate(p, model = "3PL")
#> Warning: Calibration is running with 1 block open flag(s) from earlier stages:
#>   #1 [block] possible_miskey: Q14 (p = 0.18, item-total r = -0.23)
#> Flags only warn because strict = FALSE. See flags(p).
flags(p, stage = "calibration")
#> # A tibble: 7 × 10
#>      id stage       check           target value rule  level advice status note 
#>   <int> <chr>       <chr>           <chr>  <chr> <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>  <chr>

#> 2     6 calibration dif_large       Q09    MH D… ETS … block Have … open   ""   
#> 3     3 calibration local_dependen… Q21 &… Q3 =… |Q3|… revi… The i… open   ""   
#> 4     4 calibration parameter_range Q14    a = … a in… revi… Extre… open   ""   
#> 5     5 calibration parameter_range Q21    c = … a in… revi… Extre… open   ""
